# CucumberMessages v33.0.4 - Table of Contents

> Elixir implementation of the cucumber messages json schemas

## Modules

- [CucumberMessages](https://cucumber-messages.hexdocs.pm/CucumberMessages.md): This small library its sole purpose is to convert the protobuf schema to Elixir code. In order to use this library, you do not need protoc installed at all!
